newsitem.title: USA: Wall St stocks seen off after jobless claims fall.
newsitem.headline: Wall St stocks seen off after jobless claims fall.

text.p: A surprising decline in weekly jobless claims is expected to push U.S. stocks lower at the open on Thursday.

The U.S. Labor Department reported new jobless claims fell to 319,000 for the week ended October 5, down from a revised 341,000 in the prior week. Economists had forecast claims at 342,000 for the week.
Treasuries slipped after release of the report and analysts said an already jittery stock market was likely to follow suit.
